assessment_policy: Separate correctness, contribution, priority and fertility. Classical tools do not invalidate a novel application, necessary adaptation or problem-specific guarantee. Audit priority per precise result; preserve negative outcomes as executable tests.

branch_additions.title: Joint competence compiler
branch_additions.hypothesis: Jointly compiling encoding, noisy update and executable continuation under shared physical costs can exceed separated designs.
branch_additions.reactivation_trigger: A trace locates a lost continuation distinction or an unattainable truth-table combination.
branch_additions.minimal_test: Two update libraries on the same two-stage plant; exact encoder-update-decoder search and independently verified loss/cost frontier.
branch_additions.acceptance_gate: A strict separated-design gap plus an executable joint witness and a matching bound within the library.
branch_additions.contribution: Application/method candidate; builds on value-directed compression and joint coding.

branch_additions.title: Retrieval for continuation competence
branch_additions.hypothesis: Information acquisition selected by changes to executable continuations can outperform similarity-only retrieval at matched cost.
branch_additions.reactivation_trigger: A document or observation changes an action, constraint or future maintenance choice in a trace.
branch_additions.minimal_test: Finite corpus with known task states; compare similarity, mutual information and decision-loss reduction under one physical budget.
branch_additions.acceptance_gate: Matched-budget gain on held-out finite tasks and a trace explaining which distinction changed a feasible continuation.
branch_additions.contribution: Application and experimental method candidate, not a claim that utility defines all truth.

branch_additions.title: Operational order among organizations
branch_additions.hypothesis: Task-family deficiency and physically costed policy emulation produce a partial order more informative than a universal agency score.
branch_additions.reactivation_trigger: Two architectures trade places across tasks or cannot emulate each other's executable policies.
branch_additions.minimal_test: Finite organization pairs with equal marginal capabilities; enumerate common-task values and emulation overhead.
branch_additions.acceptance_gate: Proved sufficient emulation order, explicit incomparability witness and cheapest upgrade in a finite library.
branch_additions.contribution: Conceptual/formal formulation candidate; compare to Blackwell ordering and control refinement.

branch_additions.title: Attractor geometry shaped by continuation loss
branch_additions.hypothesis: A metastable representation can protect costly continuation distinctions preferentially, outperforming uniform barrier allocation.
branch_additions.reactivation_trigger: Continuation-weighted channel distance predicts a robust advantage worth realizing in a physical landscape.
branch_additions.minimal_test: Three metastable basins with fixed initial law, deadline, intervention limits and resource calibration; compare symmetric and task-shaped barriers.
branch_additions.acceptance_gate: A same-budget physical realization of the predicted discrimination advantage with finite-noise checks and no action-dependent initial reset.
branch_additions.contribution: Physical adaptation candidate linking least action to unequal operational protection.

branch_additions.title: Replicator selection of self-maintaining architectures
branch_additions.hypothesis: Selection on material resource acquisition can favor organizations that sustain diagnostic and action channels without inserting knowledge as a fitness reward.
branch_additions.reactivation_trigger: A physically funded finite architecture family has trace-verified distinct persistence and competence mechanisms.
branch_additions.minimal_test: Replicator/environment dynamics over two complete controller architectures; ablate memory and maintenance while preserving baseline resources.
branch_additions.acceptance_gate: A reproducible regime where causally operative distinctions and upkeep are selected, with nonteleological growth rates and negative controls.
branch_additions.contribution: Foundational hypothesis; agency emergence remains an open explanatory target.

branch_additions.title: Exact trace-guided discovery
branch_additions.hypothesis: Complete small trace laws reveal hidden continuation, resource and channel structures that a scalar endpoint projection discards.
branch_additions.reactivation_trigger: Outcome comparisons fail to explain a value gap, show accidental ties or conceal conflicting context effects.
branch_additions.minimal_test: Exact stopped prefix trees; raw-kernel projection; same-outcome different-continuation witness; algebraic explanation and counterfactual coupling guard.
branch_additions.acceptance_gate: Reproduce endpoint scores exactly, expose a mechanistic separating witness and derive a statement independently checked over a finite family.
branch_additions.contribution: Executed instrument and problem-specific adaptations; 984 complete traces, fixed-policy mediator and continuation-noise certificate.

rejected_additions.claim: Equal terminal survival vectors imply equivalent organizations for future control.
rejected_additions.reason: Plans 48/63 share both alpha coordinates but have different health/resource laws; a common readable third continuation separates survival by 2.636965 pp at the fair prior.

rejected_additions.claim: A positive average control improvement benefits every hidden context.
rejected_additions.reason: The v10 code change has a negative weighted healthy-context contribution and a larger positive degraded-context contribution. Runtime still cannot observe that context.

rejected_additions.claim: Two policy-specific Markov laws determine which individual trajectories were causally rescued.
rejected_additions.reason: Shared and disjoint failure couplings have identical 80% success marginals but 0% and 20% cross-world rescue rates. Structural cross-world assumptions are required.

next_gates: R11: trace-driven minimal continuation signature for noisy updates
R14: coupled shared-component implementation and cost certificates
negative_result_retained: The fixed-REFRESH health mediator identity is not the reoptimized value gap for all initial priors; an extreme-prior policy-switch test now protects the scope.
